top_document.title: Top Document
top_document.description: The single most relevant document text (empty if none returned). Map this directly downstream.

top_score.title: Top Score
top_score.description: The relevance score of the top document (higher = more relevant).

ranked_documents.title: Ranked Documents
ranked_documents.description: The input documents reordered from most to least relevant. Use this instead of a re-sort script.

results.title: Results
results.description: The full ranked results — each has index (into the original Documents), relevance_score, and document (when Return Documents is true).

model.title: Model
model.description: The reranking model that served the request.
